audit_kind: Independent source-and-artifact resolution audit; no new training, model evaluation, Lean build, or TeX build was performed by this auditor.

status_meaning.resolved: The specific criticism is addressed at its stated scope in inspected source or traceable execution evidence. This does not certify unrelated claims or recover missing historical data.
status_meaning.partially_resolved: A substantive repair is present, but the listed evidence or factual input remains required for the broader requested claim.
status_meaning.unresolved: No sufficient repair or evidence was found.

scope_limits: This audit preserves the original reviews as historical snapshots and does not reinterpret their findings as mistakes.
Passing CPU fixtures, reaggregating stored scores, rerunning pretrained models, and reproducing historical experiments are distinct evidence levels.
No grade is assigned. The master-thesis assessment framework remains reports/thesis-reviews/assessment-criteria.md.
The local official-repository revisions have not been pushed; root release integration and final publication checks remain separate.
New activation and Transformer mathematics is undergoing separate proof and source-correspondence reviews and is not automatically certified by this empirical resolution audit.

items.criticism: A stronger ResNet localization baseline was omitted and the Selectivity gain used a weaker comparator.
items.current_assessment: The thesis and Hidden Monotonicity source now report Guided Grad-CAM AL 0.742 above SplitCAM 0.673 and Selectivity 3.503 versus the best baseline 3.517, a 0.014 gap. Abstract and surrounding summaries describe metric-specific trade-offs.

items.criticism: VOC uncertainty treated dependent image–class records as independent samples.
items.current_assessment: Official local code now resamples 2,293 original images as clusters, retaining all 2,743 class records and pairing across methods. The estimand remains the record-weighted mean. The 10,000-resample reaggregation leaves all 126 finite means and winners unchanged, changes interval widths by a median +1.47% (range -3.06% to +13.18%), and leaves all 120 against-winner significance decisions unchanged.

items.criticism: Selecting the observed best row before defining the multiple-comparison family left the significance interpretation insufficiently justified.
items.current_assessment: Holm correction now covers all eligible unordered row pairs within each displayed metric family before winner comparisons are selected. Regenerated tables add ten non-rejection markers on ImageNet comparisons. Point means and ImageNet intervals are unchanged. ResNet AL prose now states that the numerical lead over LRP-gamma is not significant.

items.criticism: A favorable derivative of an individual stream was presented as guaranteeing an improvement of the complete model score.
items.current_assessment: The DICIN derivative and qualitative captions now distinguish stream-local sensitivities, the sum giving the complete-model derivative, finite interventions, and class changes. Convexity is not used to infer the disputed full-model implication.

items.criticism: Near-zero rank correlation was called independence, non-rejection was treated as equivalence, and localization/context examples were overinterpreted.
items.current_assessment: Current prose states weak observed rank association, distinguishes non-rejection from equivalence, separates localization from faithfulness, and limits context/transfer conclusions. The final read-only recheck also confirms corrected SSIM-only superiority, mixed HOG/Spearman comparisons, and metric-dependent alpha choices in Chapter 5.

items.criticism: The Hidden Monotonicity quick start and API examples were incompatible with the shipped implementation.
items.current_assessment: Documented flags and API calls now match available interfaces; deterministic CPU decomposition, actual attribution/metric execution, precision propagation, configuration errors, and training-output smoke checks have executable coverage. The current repair receipt records 27 passing tests plus 23 subtests. These checks do not reproduce the original benchmark.

items.criticism: Missing MNIST configurations and older result inputs prevented advertised reproduction routes.
items.current_assessment: The revised guides now identify missing historical files rather than promise a runnable reproduction. The notebook-derived example is explicitly a separate current example; no historical hyperparameters were invented. The game guide now names the 13 reconstructable outputs and six missing diagnostics and no longer promises platform-independent bit-exact reevaluation.
items.remaining_action: Recover the six original MNIST configurations and per-seed outputs, the Hidden Monotonicity per-image benchmark inputs and historical environment, and central missing game diagnostics if full empirical reconstruction is claimed. Until then, retain the published-source-only qualification.

items.criticism: First authorship alone did not identify the student’s intellectual contribution.
items.current_assessment: The introduction and provenance appendix now use the author-confirmed account: developed theory, developed and ran experiments, and wrote all appendices and most paper text outside the introductions. Collaborative authorship and subsequent thesis integration remain explicit.

items.criticism: The signed declaration promises products, providers, software versions, and purposes that the disclosure did not supply.
items.current_assessment: The original game-paper declaration is identified as historical. The later thesis revision now names OpenAI Codex/OpenAI and explicitly includes mathematical exploration and proof development, formalization, code/statistical work, and editing. Historical tool identities and retained model/software version identifiers are still absent.

items.current_assessment: Both source and thesis now state the 14–29x comparison, distinguish setup from per-image timing, state what the timer includes, remove unsupported upper-bound claims, and disclose the Guided Grad-CAM label versus Guided LayerCAM configuration mismatch. items.criticism: The timing path ignored requested precision and historical measurement conditions were not identifiable.
items.current_assessment: The current timing path forwards dtype and data paths and records environment/configuration metadata. Float32 and float64 attribution/timing checks pass. The manuscript accurately identifies missing historical hardware, precision, and exact configuration IDs; the old table has not been retimed.
items.remaining_action: Recover historical timing metadata or rerun central comparisons on named hardware if stronger quantitative runtime conclusions are retained.

items.criticism: Dataset exclusions, attribution targets, and Pixel Flipping feature units differed between prose and implementation.
items.current_assessment: The manuscript now documents 752 masks to 616 label-agreeing images, 50 validation plus 566 test before the crop exclusion, and 565 final game test images. It separately describes the older HM loader, predicted-class versus dataset-class targets, CHW scalar feature counts, 96 game PF steps, and the per-step current-input mean baseline.

items.criticism: The game notation silently treated signed classifier logits as ReLU activation outputs.
items.current_assessment: The paper and thesis now append an ungated affine readout and derive its SG value/gradient and RG occupation combination, including zero rows and signed seeds. Released unit-seeded attribution is distinguished from classical logit-seeded LRP; a negative logit can reverse the latter’s sign. This is an exposition resolution, not a claim that every composite routing equilibrium has a new complete Lean certificate.

items.criticism: Attention normalization and cancellation were undefined when a sign branch had zero mass.
items.current_assessment: The paper/thesis define zero ordinary-successor ratios and cemetery completion, restrict cancellation to positive support, and state that all-zero branches have no unique maximizing key distribution. Official local code has guarded relevance division in attention, linear, and convolution hooks. Its 48 passing focused tests cover zero and one-sign streams, signed cancellation, signed incoming relevance, epsilon zero/positive, affine readout, masked attention, and bit-for-bit positive-epsilon compatibility. This resolves the written boundary and tested implementation behavior; it does not claim a complete global Lean routing-game proof.

items.criticism: The same displayed VGG configuration had incompatible reported metric values.
items.current_assessment: The appendix now explicitly records PF20 1.590 versus 1.5849 and MaxS 0.456 versus 0.4573 without inventing a seed/run explanation or altering unsupported values.
items.remaining_action: Recover the corresponding raw outputs and exact configuration/run identifiers, or keep the discrepancy and its limits visible.

items.criticism: Attribution improvements and corrected forward residuals did not independently establish numerical stabilization accuracy.
items.current_assessment: The alpha sweep is now explicitly interpreted as changing the backward rule, not isolating roundoff error. Current CPU precision fixtures provide useful bounded validation, including a 2.22e-16 output residual and zero input-Jacobian residual for a small float64 model. They do not supply the requested fixed-rule depth/scale study or pre/post-assimilation residual accounting for reported image models. The thesis now accurately states the symmetric assimilation, distinguishes common shifts from scaling, and withholds convexity/monotonicity guarantees for input-dependent corrections.
items.remaining_action: If a strong numerical-stability claim is retained, archive fixed-rule pre/post-correction errors, correction magnitudes, nonfinite counts, and gate disagreements over a bounded depth/scale and precision study.

items.criticism: The released runner used the test loader for epoch validation/early stopping and final evaluation.
items.current_assessment: The current runner now reserves a deterministic 10% training-pool holdout by default, with validation seed 42 independent of model initialization. The validation view uses evaluation preprocessing; training and validation indices are disjoint, and the original test loader is used only after fitting. Saved configurations include partition indices, hashes and sample counts. The seven affected tests plus thirteen subtests and final joint 27-test/23-subtest run pass. Final-epoch rather than automatic best-checkpoint test evaluation is explicitly documented. This repairs current evaluation roles; it does not recover missing historical configurations or retroactively validate published accuracy tables.

items.criticism: The introduction attributed convexity and monotonicity of the mathematical DC representation to every stabilized implementation variant.
items.current_assessment: The contribution summary now separates the exact convex representation from evaluated input-dependent recentering, cache correction, and winner-takes-all pooling. It explicitly withholds inherited convexity and monotonicity guarantees for the stabilized streams. The corrected assimilation explanation likewise separates common-shift invariance from scaling and detached correction.
